posts.text: PC Jewellers : A Case Study ( I am narrating it without numbers in the first instance. The business line was that the suppliers of the gold and precious gems sell goods to PCJ on 2-3 days credit. PCJ, to make payment to the suppliers, resorts to the bank/s and the borrows funds which entail interest burden/financial cost. Now, on account of negative publicity on insider trading and stern action of SEBI, its sales dip significantly which has a direct bearing to inventory turn over ratio. It is a double whammy… Sales dip, inventory at the store remains unsold and interest meters, like mumbai tax…
